description: In handle_chat_set, creating a ChatKind::Direct chat triggers get_objects::<Chat>(..., None, None) to scan all chats for the account to find a duplicate. This is O(n chats) per create call. A real backend with many chats will be slow. The backend should expose a targeted query or dedup lookup, or the spec should require a dedicated API. Currently this is the only way the library-level code can check for duplicates without backend knowledge. File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs lines 349-368.
